verdict.rationale: Pipecat's first-party pricing page states that Pipecat Cloud supports unlimited concurrency and offers different agent profiles for compute needs. That answers the core of the story, but only as a single marketing-level line with no detail on how scaling actually works. missing for 10: detailed docs on concurrency or scaling mechanics (autoscaling behavior, warm capacity, rate of ramp-up, any per-account quotas or soft limits), documentation of self-hosted scaling limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of many simultaneous calls.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
